name: Revenge After Silence The Invincible Engineer
original_name: Revenge After Silence The Invincible Engineer
overview: Sebastián Montero, a top-tier engineer, returns home after ten years in remote rural areas. Along the way, he crosses paths with Isabella Castillo—the sister of his older sister's fiancé—and discovers that the Castillos plan to seize the Montero family fortune. Sebastián decides to conceal his identity and operate covertly. When he finally reveals who he is and presents irrefutable evidence of their crimes, the Castillos are brought to justice.
